text: Tillamook is the brand of Tillamook County Creamery Association, a farmer-owned dairy cooperative; the company is owned by a group of farming families in Tillamook County, Oregon.
short: Tillamook is a brand of a farmer-owned dairy cooperative.

source.name: Tillamook: About Us (tillamook.com)
source.quote: This means that a group of farming families in Tillamook County, on the coast of Oregon, own the company and benefit directly from its growth and success.
